root_cause.text: In smb2_get_ea(), after copying an EA value, the code applies 4-byte alignment padding via memset() without first checking whether the remaining buffer (buf_free_len) is large enough to accommodate the padding bytes, leading to an out-of-bounds write when the EA value exactly fills the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check (`if (buf_free_len < alignment_bytes) break;`) before the alignment memset. The CVE description explicitly states: "When the EA value exactly fills the remaining buffer (buf_free_len == 0 after value subtraction), the alignment memset writes 1-3 NUL bytes past the buf_free_len boundary."
